title: Opera browser profile
whyItMatters: The Opera profile holds history, sessions, bookmarks and saved logins. Anyone who takes the disk can see what was browsed and which sites kept the user signed in.
source: Opera on Linux keeps its user data root in ~/.config/opera (opera://about shows the exact profile and cache paths): https://filepathgeek.com/posts/opera-browser-profile-location
notes: Opera One builds put the profile in a Default subfolder; older builds wrote Preferences directly into ~/.config/opera, which this glob does not match. Opera GX uses ~/.config/opera-gx; Beta and Developer builds have their own folders.
